7021.title: Pinned browser runtime truncates large piped results
7021.rootCauseOneLine: Pinned DevBrowser truncates piped NDJSON before BB parses it; the runtime closes the session on the parse error.
7021.proposedFix: Repair native output draining, verify large pipe results, publish the runtime, and update BB's verified runtime pin through the normal release process.
7021.caveats: Two clean trusted checkouts reproduced the native-output and BB runtime lifecycle failure using a minimal CDP connection fixture. No full public CLI or live-browser check; the 36,544-character unit and a specific native exit implementation are unverified. No PR: external runtime/release change exceeds simple-fix scope.
